description: AbstractRequestResponseClient.java is an abstract Java class implementing a request-response client pattern within an Eclipse Hono-based IoT messaging system. It manages AMQP 1.0 links, message creation, sending requests, handling responses, caching, and tracing integration, serving as a base class for specific API clients.

classes.name: AbstractRequestResponseClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for request-response style AMQP clients in Eclipse Hono, managing links, message handling, response caching, and tracing.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Abstract method to generate a unique message ID for requests.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Abstract method to create a result object from response status and payload.

methods.name: getDefaultMessageTargetAddress
methods.description: Returns the default target address for request messages. Can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: createLinks
methods.description: Creates AMQP sender and receiver links for the client.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the client links and cleans up resources.

methods.name: isCachingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if response caching is enabled.

methods.name: getResponseFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a response from cache for a given key.

methods.name: addToCache
methods.description: Adds a response to the cache with appropriate cache directives.

methods.name: isSuccessResponse
methods.description: Determines if a response with given status, content type, and payload is successful.

methods.name: mapResultAndFinishSpan
methods.description: Maps a Future<R> result via a provided function and finishes the tracing span.
